propositions: The file contains 23 call sites using _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(..., 'list') that rely on unasserted side effects to establish fixture state; under CI load with best-effort error swallowing, these preconditions silently fail producing misleading setup errors.

Eight of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions where a clone is strictly behind a peer and must be synchronized for the test to be valid; these should use deterministic _sync_from_origin (checked fetch + ff-only merge) instead of best-effort engine read.

Fifteen of the 23 sites are behavior-under-test where reconvergence through the production read path IS the assertion target; converting them would delete the invariant they prove and their failures are true signals not setup noise.

The conversion plan moves _sync_from_origin into the helper block, adds _reconverge_by_read_sync to encapsulate the deliberate best-effort read idiom for Kind-R sites, marks converted precondition asserts as SETUP, and proves the fix under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off and default environments.

A separate category of 18 raw git push legs exists outside the 23 sync-by-side-effect audit scope; one such push in _assert_emit_is_append_only fails under concurrent load due to tickets-store lock retry changes, not sync precondition issues.
